SELECT b.CATEGORY,sum(total) total,sum(right_num) as RIGHT_NUM,nvl(round(sum(right_num)/sum(total),4),0) as RIGHT_RATE from (select QUES_CODE,count(1) as total,sum(PASS_FLAG) as right_num from TRM_BRUSH_SCORE where DATA_DATE between #{begDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and #{endDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} group by QUES_CODE) a left join TRM_QUES_BANK b on (a.QUES_CODE = b.QUES_CODE) group by b.CATEGORY order by RIGHT_RATE
